description: The list of approved model versions with license, hosting, cards, eval results, retirement dates and owners, plus the aliases that point to them.
An exact, dated model snapshot id. What answers in production is what was evaluated.
A provider name like `-latest` that moves to new snapshots without your decision. Avoid it in production.
A role name owned by the application (`support-default`) that points to a pinned version and changes only through promotion.
Changing a pin only when required eval suites reach their minimums and do not regress beyond a tolerance against the current version.
The period before a version retires in which every resolution warns and names the replacement.
